For \(x>1\), repeatedly apply \(f(x)=f(x-2)\) until the argument lies in \([-1,1]\).  
Thus \(f(x)=0\) iff the reduced argument is \(\pm 1\), so the positive roots are all positive odd integers:

\[
a_n=1,3,5,\dots \quad \Rightarrow \quad a_n=2n-1.
\]

Sum first \(2017\) terms of \(\{(-1)^{n+1}a_n\}\):

\[
S=\sum_{n=1}^{2017}(-1)^{n+1}(2n-1)
=1-3+5-7+\cdots+4033.
\]

Pair terms: there are \(1008\) pairs summing to \(-2\), plus the last term \(4033\):

\[
S=1008(-2)+4033=-2016+4033=2017.
\]

\[
\boxed{2017}
\]
